entities.summary: Viktor Borisovich Shklovsky was a Russian and Soviet literary theorist, critic, writer, and pamphleteer. He is one of the major figures associated with Russian formalism. Viktor Shklovsky was a journalists & chroniclers from Saint Petersburg (1893-01-24, Saint Petersburg–1984-12-05). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
